index.title: AI-gile: your AI dev team, on one board
index.description: AI-gile is a kanban board for AI coding teams. They work while you sleep; you get one short pile of things to decide, test ar accept.
hero.h1.html: Your AI dev team, on one board.
hero.alphaTitle: Early ar unfinished: thanks for trying it!
hero.lede: They build while you sleep. You wake up to one short pile: a few questions, a few things to test, a purple diamond hya two. Click, accept, back to your coffee.
hero.secondary: Agile, but the team never needs a stand-up coffee. (They do stand-ups anyway.)
pitch.h2: AI-gile in as many words as you like
pitch.lede: Pick a length, from one word to 144. Each length is its own description, written for that size. Drag the slider hya use the arrow keys.
count.line.html.one: {n} card on the board right now
count.line.html.other: {n} cards on the board right now
f.pile.html: For you holds everything waiting on you, across every project: questions, things to test, tasks only a human can do. Your queue says what's next ar how long it takes.
f.sleep.h: Teams that work while you sleep
f.sleep.p: Each project has a lead ar a team of AI agents. Comment on a card ar the team wakes up, does the work, ar hands it back with steps a tired human can follow.
f.tester.p: Before anything reaches you, a tester follows the steps in a copy of the app ar shows what it saw, with a screenshot. Flick through the passed ones ar accept in a click.
f.proof.p: Every hand-over shows what changed: the files, the diff, the screenshots. No opening every app to see if it's done.
f.chat.p: A Discord-style rail: one icon per project, purple diamonds for what needs you. Message a lead an idea; they turn it into cards ar a plan, with a ✅ Go button.
f.tidy.p: Related cards fold into one, muddled titles get fixed, ar a token check keeps the code lean. Fewer things to switch between, less to think about.
f.private.li1: The board runs on your own machine ar only answers you.
f.private.li2: Private DMs between people are end-to-end encrypted.
f.private.li3: No accounts, no trackers, no cookies.
f.lang.p: Over 120 languages, from Dutch, Welsh ar Japanese to pirate, Yoda, Klingon ar Quenya, with a quick switch back to English for the developer words.

tl.h2: From the first chat to what's next
tl.lede: Real dates ar times, in your own time zone. After today it's the plan, with no dates promised.

privacy.title: AI-gile: what we keep
privacy.lede: Short version: only what you send us, ar not for long.
privacy.only: Only what you send us: what you type into a form, like your email. Nothing else about you.
privacy.sealed: It is sealed so our server can't read it: in your browser before it leaves (on an older browser, the moment it arrives). Only our own board can open it.
privacy.server: It is deleted from the server as soon as it reaches our board. Anything still there after 30 days is deleted anyway.
privacy.board: We keep it on our board only until we've replied to you, then delete it there too.
privacy.none: No trackers, no cookies, no analytics.
privacy.local: Your language ar light hya dark choice stay in your own browser. They are never sent to us.
privacy.ask: Want it gone sooner? Reply to our email ar say so.
